name: hcec-election-results-pages
description: Browser checks for the public pages (accessibility and performance). The pages themselves need no build.

scripts.a11y:admin: npx --yes firebase-tools@13.35.1 emulators:exec --project demo-hcec --only auth,firestore,storage,functions "node tools/seed-emulator.js && playwright test --config a11y/playwright.config.js --workers=1 --project=chromium admin"
scripts.a11y:admin:firefox: npx --yes firebase-tools@13.35.1 emulators:exec --project demo-hcec --only auth,firestore,storage,functions "node tools/seed-emulator.js && playwright test --config a11y/playwright.config.js --workers=1 --project=firefox-admin"
scripts.perf:admin: npm --prefix perf ci --no-audit --no-fund && node perf/lighthouse.mjs --pages admin.html,review.html
scripts.lint:html: html-validate index.html reporting.html precincts.html scrolling.html admin.html review.html
